body:
## Scope locked in (review answers from @diegueins680, 2026-06-04)

### 1. Definition of 'new user'
**First app install** (mobile) **AND first signup** (web + mobile). Returning-but-never-activated users are **not** enrolled — they keep whatever onboarding they originally got. Implementation: use install-time UUID on mobile + first-login flag on web to gate enrollment.

### 2. Analytics destination
**PostHog** (open-source, EU cloud, free tier covers our volume). Filed as **prerequisite #129** — this experiment is blocked until #129 ships.

### 3. Audience + chosen feature
**Pivoted to Event RSVP as the single feature** (was vCard). Rationale: works equally well for in-person + remote users, vCard QR is too in-person-only for the audience mix.

**Follow-on:** once RSVP onboarding ships, the next experiment is to surface **in-event vCard exchange** to RSVP'd users — fans who confirmed for the same event get a 'Meet other fans here' surface that opens the vCard scanner with social context. That's a separate issue I'll file once #128 has data; tracking it here as a connected idea so we design the RSVP flow with that follow-up in mind.

### 4. 'First meaningful action' = RSVP broadcast
For the chosen Event RSVP feature, the success event is:

> **A new user submits an RSVP, AND that RSVP gets broadcast to the fanclub members of the artist playing the event.**

The broadcast is the engagement amplifier — it's what turns a private 'I'm going' into social proof inside the fanclub. Implementation note: **the broadcast-to-fanclub path is new backend work** — the repo has `FanClubPost` and validators in `tdf-hq/src/TDF/ServerFanClub.hs` but no RSVP-triggered broadcast yet. Will need a new `broadcastRsvpToFanclub` server action that:
1. Looks up the event's headlining artist
2. Resolves the artist's fanclub members
3. Posts a `FanClubPost` (or a lighter 'activity feed' event if we want to avoid spam) on each new RSVP
4. Respects fanclub members' notification preferences (must exist or be added)

This means #128 has a sub-task: **'Backend: RSVP-to-fanclub broadcast'** — I'll file it as **#130** after this comment lands.

### 5. Holdout arm — YES, three-arm design
Run with three arms instead of two for cleaner attribution:

| Arm | Onboarding modal | Tab bar on first launch | First screen |
|---|---|---|---|
| **control** | yes (current 3-step) | full (6 tabs) | `/(tabs)/parties` |
| **treatment_singlefeature** | skipped | hidden, replaced with 'Explore more →' link | Event RSVP focused screen |
| **treatment_notabbar** | skipped | hidden, replaced with 'Explore more →' link | `/(tabs)/parties` (same content as control) |

The third arm isolates 'the modal sucks' from 'single-feature focus helps'. If `treatment_notabbar` ≈ `control` but worse than `treatment_singlefeature`, focus wins. If all three diverge, both effects matter independently.

Weights: 0.34 / 0.33 / 0.33.

### 6. Sample size + power
Target: **100 new users/week**. With three arms that's ~33/arm/week. At a 15% baseline D1 retention and looking for a 5pp absolute lift, we need ~700 users/arm for 80% power at α=0.05 → **~6 weeks minimum** to call the experiment. **Run for 6–8 weeks**, monitor weekly but don't peek-and-decide before week 6.

If new-user rate stays below ~50/week through week 3, shorten the primary metric to a noisier-but-louder binary ('completed first RSVP in session 0: yes/no') and reduce the lift threshold; we'll add that decision rule when we see week-3 numbers.

### 7. Scope: mobile + web
**Expanded to web (`tdf-hq-ui`) in addition to mobile.** Both surfaces need:
- the same three-arm split
- the same 'first feature' (Event RSVP focused page)
- the same 'Explore more →' escape hatch
- the same experiment ID for cross-surface analysis

Web onboarding today drops users on `/dashboard`. Treatment will drop them on a focused `/welcome/rsvp` (or equivalent) route with the next event card and one CTA.

### 8. Reviewer
**@diegueins680** — single sign-off path. I will draft the implementation PRs once #129 (analytics) is merged. **Will not start implementation until #129 ships.**

---

## Updated dependency chain

```
#129 (PostHog analytics)  ──►  #130 (RSVP→fanclub backend broadcast)
                                 │
                                 ▼
                              #128 (this issue: single-feature onboarding A/B test)
```

Both #129 and #130 block this.
